invariants: Focusa Desktop is a presenter, not a product
native/Tauri/local commands never call storage or reducer code directly
value-producing mutation forwards to the shared core execution guard (daemon)
the bridge never evaluates entitlement; the daemon core guard decides
unknown or unregistered desktop actions fail closed before execution
commercial decisions live in the canonical resolver, not the presenter
presenters never mint grants, License Types, prices, families, limits, or nodes
no caller-controlled product, price, License Type, family, feature, limit, node, or commercial right
clients on the same node do not consume separate nodes
no raw email, key, token, customer row, credential, or card data

rules: no disabled control traps the customer away from data or purchase
denied value actions carry an accessible explanation and an Operator/Bundle upgrade or recovery action
read, export, recovery, repair, update, and uninstall are never disabled by an entitlement decision
limited mode preserves read, export, and recovery (Spec 172 §17)
desktop decisions equal core/API output; the presenter never owns commercial policy

navigation_display.description: UI state changes, tray/window toggles, dialog open/close. No daemon call; no entitlement check; no storage mutation.

recovery_account.description: License/entitlement status refresh, connection management, pairing lifecycle, update operations, debug bundle copy, saved connection preference. Always reachable per account_recovery family.

canonical_operation.description: Invokes a Focusa daemon operation with side effects. Policy inherited from the canonical operation's registered family and decided by the daemon core guard.

actions.description: Toggle the desktop tray/popover window; local UI, no daemon call.
Navigate between desktop views; local UI, no daemon call.
Close a desktop dialog; local UI, no daemon call.
Refresh entitlement posture via GET /v1/license/status.
Probe daemon health via GET /v1/health.
Start device pairing via POST /v1/pairing/start.
Revoke a paired device via POST /v1/pairing/revoke.
List paired devices via GET /v1/pairing/devices.
Check for signed update via GET /v1/update/notifications.
Install signed update via POST /v1/update/install; stable security allowance.
Copy debug bundle to clipboard for diagnostics.
Save a connection URL to presenter-local preference storage.
Verify active project binding via GET /v1/project/identity.
Verify current workpoint via GET /v1/workpoint/current.
Create workpoint checkpoint via POST /v1/workpoint/checkpoint.
Resume workpoint via POST /v1/workpoint/resume.
Link evidence to workpoint via POST /v1/workpoint/evidence/link.
Execute selected semantic pair operation via POST /v1/semantic-integrity/operations/{id}.
Add a sync peer via POST /v1/sync/peers.
Pull sync data from peer via POST /v1/sync/pull/{peer_id}.
First-run daemon discovery probe via GET /v1/health.
First-run device pairing via POST /v1/pairing/start.
First-run project binding verification via GET /v1/project/identity.
First-run workpoint verification via GET /v1/workpoint/current.

invariants: Focusa Desktop is a presenter, not a product
zero local entitlement authority: no local grants, no local license tables, no local prices
zero direct-storage mutation bypass: value-producing mutation forwards to the shared core execution guard
unknown or unregistered desktop actions fail closed before execution
every desktop action maps to a canonical operation decision from core/API
read, export, and recovery controls are never disabled
disable only denied operations; paid families blocked consistently with CLI/API
clients on the same node do not consume separate nodes; Desktop never registers a node
no local commercial policy cache; no caller-supplied product, price, License Type, family, feature, limit, or node
no raw email, key, token, customer row, credential, or card data
no implicit legacy Download 453 mapping

license_type_display.verified_no_license: Verified no-license limited access (no automatic expiry)

spec172.node_semantics: one verified operator seat; up to three registered operator nodes; Focusa Desktop, CLI, TUI, Pi, menubar, and Cockpit clients on the same node do not consume separate nodes; Desktop never counts apps as nodes and never registers a node
spec172.same_node_identity: Focusa Desktop uses same-node identity: it never creates a node, activation, seat, or node counter of its own; CLI/menubar/Desktop on the same node share the authority's registered node identity

no_direct_core_bypass.rule: Desktop, Tauri, native, and local-source commands MUST NOT bypass entitlement by calling storage or reducer code directly (Spec 172 §11.4)
no_direct_core_bypass.bridge_enforcement: every value-producing desktop action carries a daemon route and forwards to the shared core execution guard; the bridge holds no storage/reducer path by construction

rules: every first-run step resolves through the desktop action registry to a canonical operation or a presenter-local display step
first-run never creates a grant, node, price, or License Type locally
pairing proves identity/device posture, not entitlement (Spec 172 §11.3)
denied value actions carry an accessible explanation and an Operator/Bundle upgrade or recovery action
read, export, recovery, repair, update, and uninstall are never disabled by an entitlement decision
desktop decisions equal core/API output; presenters never own commercial policy

spec172.disable_policy: disable only denied operations; never disable read, export, recovery, repair, update, or uninstall; paid families (team_remote, automation, release_proof, premium_updates, customer_data_export) blocked consistently with the canonical decision mapping
